title: MetaSapiens: Real-Time Neural Rendering with Efficiency-Aware Pruning and Accelerated Foveated Rendering
problem: Point-Based Neural Rendering (PBNR), particularly 3D Gaussian Splatting, is computationally too expensive to run in real time on mobile devices due to the large number of Gaussian primitives and the full-resolution rendering required.
motivation: AR/VR and digital twin applications demand real-time, photorealistic rendering on mobile hardware, but current PBNR methods cannot meet the stringent latency and power constraints of such devices.
method: MetaSapiens combines two techniques: (1) efficiency-aware pruning that reduces the number of Gaussian primitives based on their contribution to rendering quality, using a pruning criterion that accounts for both visual importance and computational cost on the target hardware; and (2) accelerated foveated rendering that exploits the human visual system's reduced acuity in peripheral regions by rendering the foveal region at full quality and peripheral regions at lower resolution or with fewer Gaussians, reducing total computation. Both techniques are co-designed with the mobile hardware execution model to maximize throughput.
key_novelty: Co-designing efficiency-aware Gaussian pruning with hardware-targeted foveated rendering to achieve real-time PBNR on mobile devices.
contributions: Efficiency-aware pruning criterion for Gaussian Splatting balancing visual quality and hardware cost
Accelerated foveated rendering reducing peripheral region computation
Real-time PBNR execution on mobile hardware through combined pruning and foveation

metrics.other: not stated in abstract; claims real-time PBNR on mobile devices

baselines: unoptimized 3D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices
limitations: Foveated rendering requires accurate eye-tracking hardware; pruning criteria may not generalize across diverse scene types not discussed in abstract.
primary_theme: efficiency-aware pruning and foveated rendering for mobile neural rendering
